conflicts.question: What exact event counts as a verified download versus adoption?
conflicts.resolution: A verified adoption event is one server-confirmed successful file download with full delivery confirmation. Count it as adoption within a 90-day window. Report no adoption or conversion numbers until this measurement is implemented.
conflicts.agentBehavior: Definition approved. Do not report adoption or conversion figures until the server-confirmed measurement is implemented and verified.

conflicts.question: Is the visually absent homepage wordmark an implementation defect, intentional exception, or canonical identity change?
conflicts.resolution: Confirmed as a bug. Restore the existing wordmark treatment and keep it visible. Not an intentional exception and not an identity change.
conflicts.agentBehavior: Treat invisible wordmark as a defect to fix against the existing standard. Do not normalize or reuse the invisible treatment.
